## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (compile, typecheck, lint, format, tests).
- [ ] New behavior has tests, next to the module they test.
- [ ] User-facing changes are described under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] `docs/usage.md` (and `README.md` for headline features) describe new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Test data contains no real logs, tokens, or personal data.
